# An expression completes only its trailing token. The count that drives the
# plural category is the one next to the fragment, not the one at the front —
# and Ukrainian has four categories where English has two, so "5 грамів"
# (genitive plural) is the row that would read as "5 грам" if the category
# KNOWN WRONG, recorded rather than hidden: after "в" Ukrainian takes the
# locative, so this should offer "2 км в милях". `complete()` never tells
# `selectForm` that the fragment is a conversion target, so the slot arrives
# as the default and an implied count of 1 selects "nom-one" — the nominative
# singular. English cannot see it: its inch and its mile are the same word in
# both positions, so "2 km in mile" is correct there for the wrong reason.
# `evaluate("2 кг в грамах")` is unaffected; this is the completion path only.
# Ціль конверсії пропонує лише ті одиниці, до яких ліва частина справді

# Українська перевіряє це через свій сполучник "в", а не через англійське
